name: Progress tracker
purpose: Shows users how far they are through a multi-step process by filling a segmented track and labelling the current step (e.g. 'Step 2 of 4').

props.name: currentStep
props.$note: 1…totalSteps; segments up to the current step use progress/complete, the rest progress/incomplete.

tokens.track-complete: step/complete — #176 (WORKING, awaiting Dave's eye): INHERITS THE SUCCESS-ROUNDEL SYSTEM WHOLESALE. The token now aliases rag/success, the exact chain the RAG roundels bind, so each theme takes ITS OWN success colour rather than a hard-coded hex: Mono #66CC8D, Console #5DAC7B, Supercharge #5DAC7B, all mode-invariant. LEGACY IS THE ONE EXCEPTION and overrides to its ERROR red #A8000B in light and #FFFFFF in dark (the roundel policy's white-in-dark leg) — Dave: 'Except Legacy, it uses the red in light mode and white in dark.' The #175 'UNDECIDED for Mono/Console/Supercharge' park is discharged by that ruling. RETIRED, quoted so the trail survives: REBOUND #175 by s175-D1 from progress/complete; values were unchanged in all four themes — Mono/Console ink pair #1A1A1A|#FFFFFF, Legacy #DB0011, Supercharge #B92F1E|#CC4333. | #176 REFINEMENTS RULED OFF THE RENDERED v1 REVIEW PAGE (which outranks the chat legs): LEGACY LIGHT IS THE PRIMARY RED #DB0011, not the error red — Dave: 'Use the primary red for Legacy.' Sequence by addition: #DB0011 (s175) -> #A8000B (chat, self-corrected) -> #DB0011 (ruled off the page). Dark #FFFFFF untouched. THE MARK IS DARK INK, NOT THE PAGE: --on-complete now binds the NEW token step/on-complete, #1A1A1A mode-invariant — Dave: 'Apollo mono, in the same way as the roundels, uses the dark ink colour for the glyphs.' That is the s122-D2 mark camp, and Mono/Console/Supercharge all already declare #1A1A1A for the success roundel mark (verified first-hand in their marks blocks). Legacy overrides: #FFFFFF light (its own roundel mark, s122-D5) and #1A1A1A dark as a DECLARED EXCEPTION, because Legacy's dark step fill is #FFFFFF and an exact match would be a white tick on a white disc — that leg is NOT RULED by Dave and is flagged for him. RETIRED: the knock-to-page mark, background/default, #FFFFFF light / #1A1A1A dark. THE TICK IS THE THICK ASSET status-icons/yes-thick.svg (was status-icons/yes.svg) — 'Please use the thick tick icon for all'. CONTRAST DOCTRINE, Dave verbatim: 'the intent/meaning is carried by the glyph a label ... the label and the symbol must carry the contrast not the decoration.' GATED: tick-on-fill (3:1) and label-on-page (4.5:1). DECLARED ABSENCE: fill-on-page, fill-on-track.
tokens.track-complete-mark: step/on-complete — the completed-step check glyph is the ROUNDEL'S DARK INK #1A1A1A, mode-invariant (s122-D2 mark camp; Dave #176: 'Apollo mono, in the same way as the roundels, uses the dark ink colour for the glyphs'). Legacy overrides (#FFFFFF light, matching its own roundel mark; #1A1A1A dark as a flagged, NOT-RULED exception against its white dark fill). RETIRED: 'background/default — the completed-step check glyph KNOCKS TO THE PAGE, the RAG roundel mark policy, replacing the white-fixed text/on-inverse mark (#176, WORKING).' The mark policy binds to the FILL, not the token name.
tokens.label: text/default (#333333) @ font-5/medium (step) + font-5/light
tokens.$finding: (2026-06-20) progress/complete + progress/incomplete were BOTH flat #FFFFFF in dark (segments indistinguishable; the dark-surface gate misses non-surface fills). Reconciled: complete=#DB0011 (brand red), incomplete=#404040. Distinguished by hue.

accessibility.status: Expose as a progress indicator with an accessible name and current/total (role=progressbar with aria-valuenow/valuemin/valuemax, or descriptive text 'Step 2 of 4')
accessibility.useOfColour: The red/grey fill must not be the only cue — pair with the step text label (1.4.1)
accessibility.announce: REVIEW (inferred): step changes should be announced (aria-live) as the user advances

antiPatterns: Showing progress by the bar fill alone without a 'Step X of Y' label
REVIEW (inferred): using a progress tracker for an unknown number of steps (use an indeterminate loading indicator instead)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS — CLEAN, no deprecated tokens. Uses the dedicated progress/* pair + text/default.

depricateUsage.note: None. progress/complete (#db0011) + progress/incomplete (#ededed) are live semantic tokens.

build.$status: PROMOTED 2026-06-22 (Dave) — gated reference: snippets/Progress-tracker.reference.html. Build green; prototype-grade 9.0/9.
build.$visualCorrection: Canon previously rendered a dots-and-connectors stepper (numbered circles + connector lines + per-step labels) — that diverged from this meta and the Figma. Corrected to the SEGMENTED TRACK the source defines (node 267:10760): a 'Step X of Y' label + optional title + flat filled segments (progress/complete up to the current step, progress/incomplete after).
build.interactiveDecision: PASSIVE (interactive:false) status display, like Table + Status-indicator — NOT a navigation control. AT earned the passive way: role=progressbar + aria-valuenow/valuemin/valuemax + aria-valuetext + an aria-live 'Step X of Y' announcement + accessible name. A real Back/Next control drives it and carries the interactive hover/active/focus/disabled states honestly (same pattern Status-indicator used). No clickable-step navigation bolted on.
build.prototypeGrade: 9.0/9 (2026-06-22). Square segments (brand angular); flexible-width track + @container nav reflow; colour never the only cue (the 'Step X of Y' label carries meaning, 1.4.1).
